label: NOTE: independent V.90 5.4.2/5.4.3 checks
why: This suite is for a standards oracle that computes R = sum(b_i 2^i), performs five explicit mixed-radix divisions, and checks the residual sixth digit against M5. The existing moduluscoder suite is differential and already covers reverse traversal, whole-byte input, signedness, several modulus/order errors, and the obvious out[5] modulo-M5 alternative. These mutations use distinct anchors and focus on bit weights, remainder arithmetic, the strict sixth-digit boundary, and decoder reconstruction.
